student_learning_goal: I can describe a community situation and ask a math question about it.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can describe a community situation and ask a math question about it.
header.character_watermark: Coach Cara in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a community location. Draw or write 2-3 sentences describing it.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. A description box.

image_placeholders.description: A description box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'Community location: ___' on top. 3 description lines below. Header 'My Community Description:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_DESC: keywords (community, description) name the box.

parts.student_instructions: Write 4 math questions about your community. Use HOW MANY, HOW MUCH, HOW LONG.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four numbered question lines.

image_placeholders.description: Four numbered question slots in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Header 'My Math Questions:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_Q: keywords (math, questions) name the slots.

parts.student_instructions: Sort 6 questions into MATH and NOT MATH. Mark M or N.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A 6-row sort chart.

image_placeholders.description: A 6-row sort chart in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Pre-filled questions; M/N bubbles. Header 'Math (M) or Not Math (N)?'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_SORT: keywords (math) name the bubbles.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and answer 1 math question with a guess.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 worksheet. Watch for opinion-vs-math at community scale.
